description: Zambezi River Basin Land Use, Land Use Change and Soil Erosion is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This dataset provides Land Use, Land Use Change and Soil Loss (Area: Shire sub basin) at 10m resolution. Coverage: Malawi. It has 4 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
